brief.t: A private bank started in 1931 as Travancore Federal Bank; K.P. Hormis took charge in 1945 and moved its office to Aluva, Kerala, where it is still headquartered.
Led by MD & CEO KVS Manian (ex-Joint MD of Kotak Mahindra Bank) since 23 Sep 2024; former IAS officer Elias George became Part-time Chairman on 23 May 2026.
In 2025–26 Blackstone agreed to invest about ₹6,196 crore for up to 9.99% of the bank through warrants; RBI approved it and the warrants were allotted in Feb 2026.
FY 2025-26 standalone net profit rose 1.6% to ₹4,117 crore; Gross NPA fell to 1.62%.
Q2 FY27 (Jul–Sep 2026) profit jumped 45.1% to a record ₹1,386 crore, and Gross NPA fell to 1.32%, a ten-year low.

timeline.t: Started as Travancore Federal Bank at Nedumpuram, near Thiruvalla.
Under K.P. Hormis, the bank moved its registered office to Aluva.
KVS Manian took over as MD & CEO for three years.
Board approved a ₹6,196 crore warrant issue to a Blackstone affiliate.
RBI cleared Blackstone's stake of up to 9.99%; warrants allotted with ₹1,549 crore paid upfront.

model.how: Federal Bank earns mainly from the interest gap between loans and deposits, plus fees. It is known for deposits from Non-Resident Indians (NRIs), especially from Kerala's Gulf diaspora, and owns the lending company Fedbank Financial Services (Fedfina).
flow: Customers and NRIs deposit money (savings, current, NRI deposits)
Bank lends to people, businesses and farmers

points: RBI must approve a private bank's CEO and Chairman, and any investor buying 5% or more; it cleared Blackstone's stake in Feb 2026.
Global investors are buying into Indian banks; Blackstone in Federal Bank is one example.
Banks are tidying up bad loans; Federal Bank's Gross NPA is at a ten-year low.

numbers.say: Federal Bank posted a record ₹1,386 crore profit last quarter, up 45%, with bad loans at a ten-year low, and Blackstone has invested in it.

rivals.note: Federal Bank is a mid-sized private bank: smaller than the big four, but larger by profit than AU, IDFC FIRST and IndusInd in FY26.

rows.v: GIFT City IFSC unit; rep. offices in Dubai and Abu Dhabi

network.local: Federal Bank's roots are in Kerala, but it now has branches across India, and its Gulf offices serve the large NRI customer base.

employer.note: From the FY 2025-26 BRSR (31 Mar 2026). The bank is growing its branch network and business fast, so retail, sales and credit roles are in demand.

csr.t: Federal Bank's CSR covers education (Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation scholarships), skill academies, healthcare and cancer screening, cyber-safety awareness and tree planting.

glossary.Net profit: What is left after all costs, provisions and taxes. The bank's final earnings.
glossary.Net Interest Income: Interest earned on loans minus interest paid on deposits. A bank's main earning.
glossary.Net interest margin: Net Interest Income as a % of the bank's interest-earning assets. Shows how profitable lending is.
glossary.Gross NPA: Non-Performing Asset: a loan not repaid for 90+ days. Gross NPA is the % of all loans that have gone bad.
glossary.Net NPA: Bad loans after subtracting the money already set aside (provisions) for them. Lower is better.
glossary.CASA ratio: Share of deposits in Current and Savings accounts. These pay little interest, so a higher CASA means cheaper funds.
glossary.Capital adequacy ratio: The bank's own capital compared with the risk in its loans. RBI requires a minimum; higher means safer.
glossary.Provisions: Money set aside from profit to cover loans that may not be repaid.
glossary.Deposits: Money customers keep with the bank in savings, current and fixed deposit accounts.
glossary.Advances: Loans given by the bank to customers and businesses.
glossary.Dividend: Part of the profit paid to shareholders, per share.
glossary.Treasury gains: Profit from buying and selling bonds and other investments. It can swing a lot each quarter.
glossary.Attrition: The % of employees who leave in a year. Also called employee turnover.
glossary.RBI: Reserve Bank of India, which regulates all banks in India.
glossary.KYC: Know Your Customer: checking a customer's identity before opening an account.
glossary.MSME: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: small businesses that banks lend to.
glossary.Cross-sell: Selling an extra product (like a credit card) to an existing customer.
glossary.Public sector bank: A bank where the Government of India owns the majority of shares.
glossary.BRSR: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report: an official yearly report on people, environment and governance that big listed companies must publish.
glossary.NRI deposits: Money kept in Indian banks by Non-Resident Indians, such as people from Kerala working in the Gulf.
glossary.Warrants: A right to buy a company's shares later at a fixed price. Blackstone paid 25% upfront for Federal Bank warrants.
glossary.Provision coverage ratio: The share of bad loans a bank has already set money aside for. Federal Bank's was about 87% in Sep 2026.

Role knowledge, the bank and HR questions

Finance.q: Why did Federal Bank's FY26 profit grow only 1.6% while Q2 FY27 profit jumped 45%?
Finance.a: FY26 carried high provisions, including floating provisions in Q4; in Q2 FY27 interest income grew 26%, fees grew 32% and slippages fell.

Finance.q: How does Blackstone's warrant deal work?
Finance.a: Blackstone's arm got warrants at ₹227 each, paid 25% upfront (about ₹1,549 cr) and pays the rest on conversion into shares, for up to 9.99%.

Finance.q: What does a Gross NPA of 1.32% tell you?
Finance.a: Only about 1.3% of loans are bad, a ten-year low for the bank, which shows careful lending and good recovery.

Marketing.q: How would you grow Federal Bank's NRI business further?
Marketing.a: Target Gulf and new diaspora markets with easy digital account opening, low-cost remittances and regional-language campaigns.

Marketing.q: How would you build the brand outside Kerala?
Marketing.a: Digital-first products, campus and salary-account tie-ups, and city campaigns that show a modern bank with a long history.

HR.q: How would you keep a 17,000-strong workforce motivated during fast growth?
HR.a: Clear career paths, regular training, recognising good work and listening to branch staff.

Sales.q: Sell a Federal Bank NRI account to a nurse moving to Dubai.
Sales.a: Ask about her goals, then explain easy remittance, NRE/NRO accounts, safety and app access, and close with a next step.

Operations.q: How would you handle a big jump in loan applications without delays?
Operations.a: Digital document checks, automated credit scoring, clear turnaround targets and daily tracking.

Other.a: A Kerala-based private bank started in 1931, led by MD & CEO KVS Manian, with a record ₹1,386 cr profit in Q2 FY27 and Blackstone as a new investor.

gd.t: Should foreign investors own large stakes in Indian banks?
gd.for: They bring capital and global practices, as Blackstone has done with Federal Bank.
gd.against: Too much foreign control may not suit national banking goals.

gd.t: Are NRI deposits a strength or a risk for a bank?
gd.for: They are large and stable, and crossed ₹1 lakh cr at Federal Bank.
gd.against: They depend on Gulf jobs and global conditions.

avoid: Don't quote an old CEO name; KVS Manian has led the bank since Sep 2024.
Don't say Blackstone owns or controls the bank; it can hold up to 9.99% after converting warrants.
Don't call the Jana SFB deal confirmed; in Aug 2026 the bank said there was nothing material to disclose.
